question: What is the minimum attendance required to sit for end-semester exams?
expected_answer: 80% in each subject (100% is required; up to 20% absence may be relaxed for valid reasons)

question: What happens if my attendance is between 70% and 80%?
expected_answer: The Dean/Director may give up to 10% exemption after an individual hearing; then you may appear for the regular term-end exam

question: What happens if my attendance is below 70%?
expected_answer: You must take re-admission in the same year of study in the next academic year

question: How soon must I report an error in my monthly attendance record?
expected_answer: In writing within 3 days of the attendance record being published

question: When are parents informed about attendance?
expected_answer: Monthly by email/SMS if the student's attendance is below 80%

question: How early should I reach the exam hall?
expected_answer: At least 30 minutes before the exam starts; latecomers are not permitted without written approval from the Dean/Director

question: Can I carry a smartwatch or calculator into the exam hall?
expected_answer: No - books, notes, mobile phones, smart watches, earbuds and calculators are forbidden unless permitted

question: Can I write my name or roll number in the answer book?
expected_answer: No - answer books are barcoded/QR coded; writing identifying details is treated as unfair means

question: What is the deadline to apply for re-valuation of an answer book?
expected_answer: Within 3 days from the date of result declaration (including holidays)

question: What is the deadline to apply for a photocopy of my answer book?
expected_answer: Within 2 days from the date of result declaration (including holidays)

question: What percentage of fees is refunded if I withdraw more than 30 days after the last date of admission?
expected_answer: 0% - no refund

question: What refund do I get if I withdraw 15 days or more before the last date of admission?
expected_answer: 100% minus processing charges of up to 5% (maximum Rs. 5000)

question: How much does a duplicate fee receipt cost?
expected_answer: Rs. 100 per receipt via the Application for Duplicate Fee Receipt at Accounts

question: How long does a hostel deposit refund take?
expected_answer: About 3 weeks after submitting the signed receipt and refund application

question: Are bags allowed in the library?
expected_answer: No - bags are not allowed in the library

question: Are mobile phones allowed on campus?
expected_answer: No - use of cell phones on campus is not permitted and attracts a penalty

question: Which national scholarships can NMIMS students apply for?
expected_answer: Central Sector Scheme, Merit-cum-Means, Post Matric (Minorities), PM Scholarship Scheme for CAPF & Assam Rifles, and UGC scholarships - apply through the school academic office

question: Within how many days must I submit the signed Student Undertaking?
expected_answer: Within 7 days of receiving the SRB, to the Course Coordinator

question: What is the passing criteria for a subject at MPSTME?
expected_answer: Minimum 40% in the semester-end exam and 40% overall; 40-49.99 gets a D grade (low pass)

question: Are grace marks given at MPSTME?
expected_answer: No - there is no provision for grace marks

question: How are marks split between ICA and the end-semester exam?
expected_answer: 50 marks ICA (mid-term/assignments/quizzes etc.) and 50 marks semester-end exam

question: What happens if I fail a subject?
expected_answer: You appear for the semester-end re-examination after results; ICA marks carry forward and you must fill the online re-exam form and pay the fee

question: Can I be promoted to the next year with 2 F grades?
expected_answer: Yes - up to the equivalent of two F grades (two Ds count as one F) is allowed under ATKT

question: Is progression allowed with 1 F and 3 D grades?
expected_answer: No - 1F with 3 or more Ds is not allowed

question: What is ATKT?
expected_answer: Allowed To Keep Terms - students who fail Semester I subjects can attend Semester II and take re-exams

question: Is there a re-exam for courses with only ICA evaluation?
expected_answer: No - you must take re-admission in the same semester in the next academic year

question: What is the maximum duration allowed to complete B Tech?
expected_answer: 6 years (normal duration 4 years)

question: What is the maximum duration allowed to complete MBA Tech?
expected_answer: 7 years (normal duration 5 years)

question: How long is the internship for B Tech students?
expected_answer: An entire semester (during the last semester of the program)

question: What is a PPO?
expected_answer: Pre-Placement Offer - a job offer by the company to an intern based on internship performance

question: How do I opt out of placements?
expected_answer: Formally notify the Placement Office using the 'Opted Out Form' with the reason

question: Which foreign universities does MPSTME have MoUs with?
expected_answer: Virginia Tech, Stevens Institute of Technology, UNSW, University at Buffalo, Hochschule Karlsruhe, Binghamton University, Cranfield University

expected_answer: Dr. Dhirendra Mishra (dhirendra.Mishra@nmims.edu)
